description: This file defines core functions for a web server plugin, including WSGI application handling, HTML caching, user authentication, and xsendfile support, along with associated actions.

methods.name: wsgi
methods.description: Sets up a WSGI application route with a URL prefix and backend actions.

methods.name: cached_html
methods.description: Returns a cached HTML handler, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: auth_require_user
methods.description: Requires specified authenticated users, matching against REMOTE_USER.

methods.name: xsendfile
methods.description: Sets up xsendfile support with a specified document root.
